operator_implementation.bounded_execution_replay: The terminal selection database is scanned through condition-sized batches twice only when no valid economic checkpoint exists.
operator_implementation.input_lineage: A pre-fit manifest binds every development sample identity and target population to the base feature, BBO overlay, target-store, contract, and implementation audits.
operator_implementation.persistence: Manifest, selection claim, and economic report are canonical, atomic, immutable restart checkpoints.
operator_implementation.resume_validation: A persisted economic report is reused only after recursive nested scenario, gate, model, resolution, selection, and recomputed input-manifest validation.
operator_implementation.sealed_policy: The operator opens only train, calibration, and selection targets and cannot grant paper or live order authority.
operator_implementation.unavailable_or_failed_gate: persist the rejection and do not run sealed evaluation
